goal.title: Individuelle Verdauungs- und Resorptionsunterschiede begründen
goal.titleEn: Justify individual differences in digestion and resorption
goal.description: Die lernende Person kann genetisch bedingte oder erworbene individuelle Unterschiede bei Verdauung und Resorption von Nahrungsbestandteilen chemisch begründen.
goal.descriptionEn: The learner can chemically justify genetically caused or acquired individual differences in digestion and resorption of food components.

wholeContexts.wholePrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: German upper-secondary chemistry learning-goal orientation image. Create a friendly abstract comic illustration as an opaque PNG, wide landscape close to 16:9, approximately 1600 by 900 pixels. Clear large shapes readable at 360 pixels image width, warm pale backdrop, colored outlines, no photorealism, no tiny text, no technical IDs. Primary request: illustrate why digestion of lactose differs when lactase is present versus absent. Two spacious side by side lanes, each with the same pale blue lactose substrate represented as TWO joined colored pieces. Top lane has a friendly green enzyme with a fitting pocket, splits the joined lactose into exactly two separate colored monosaccharide pieces; bottom lane lacks that enzyme, and the joined lactose passes onward unsplit to a simple abstract intestine icon. Only these three large German labels: 'Lactose', 'mit Lactase', 'ohne Lactase'. Chemical constraints: enzyme is unchanged after acting; hydrolysis is represented as cleavage rather than disappearance; show no medical diagnosis, no person in pain, no moral judgement, no universal claim about tolerance. This is a qualitative conceptual model, not an atomic formula or a laboratory execution. Use broad shapes with sufficient whitespace; labels secondary to the visible contrast.

wholePrerequisites.title: Verdauungssäfte chemisch erklären
wholePrerequisites.description: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung verschiedener Verdauungssäfte aus chemischer Sicht erklären und Bezüge zu pH-Wert, Löslichkeit und Stoffumwandlung herstellen.
wholePrerequisites.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the role of different digestive juices from a chemical perspective and relate them to pH, solubility, and substance transformation.

goal.title: Optische Aktivität und Polarimetrie auswerten
goal.description: Die lernende Person kann optische Aktivität chiraler Naturstoffe erläutern, den spezifischen Drehwinkel als Kenneigenschaft beschreiben und Polarimetrie zur Charakterisierung optisch aktiver Substanzen fachlich einordnen.
goal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain optical activity of chiral natural substances, describe specific rotation as a characteristic property, and classify polarimetry for characterizing optically active substances.

wholeContexts.wholePrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: orientation image for German upper-secondary chemistry. Opaque PNG, wide landscape approximately 16:9 at around 1600 by 900 pixels. Friendly abstract comic, rounded shapes, colored outlines, pale cream background, ample whitespace, main shapes legible at 360 pixels width. No photorealism, no tiny text, no technical IDs, no elaborate chart. Only show the requested chemistry faithfully; this is a conceptual model, not a performed experiment. Illustrate optical activity in a polarimeter using orientation planes. Three big components on one horizontal optical axis: polarizer on left, transparent sample tube at centre containing a simple pale solution, analyser on right. Light travels left to right with broad arrow. Before the sample, a bright flat blue light-plane ribbon is VERTICAL. After the sample it is a distinct orange plane ribbon rotated moderately about the SAME horizontal propagation axis. Include an inset facing along the beam: one vertical blue line and one tilted orange line from same centre, with a short curved angle arrow between them. Only two large labels 'Probe' above tube and 'Drehung' beside inset. Scientific constraints: rotation of polarization plane, not bending light path; tube stays horizontal; no corkscrew trajectory, no prism, no D/L sign claim, no numeric angle, no claim any chiral sample must show nonzero. Friendly abstract comic diagram, not sterile engineering screenshot.

wholePrerequisites.title: Aminosäuren charakterisieren
wholePrerequisites.description: Die lernende Person kann Struktur, Zwitterionenbildung, amphoteres Verhalten im Donator-Akzeptor-Konzept, Säure-Base-Eigenschaften, Chiralität, Enantiomerie, Fischer-Projektion sowie D-/L-Konfiguration proteinogener Aminosäuren darstellen.
wholePrerequisites.descriptionEn: The learner can depict structure, zwitterion formation, amphoteric acid-base behavior, chirality, enantiomerism, Fischer projection, and D/L configuration of proteinogenic amino acids.

wholePrerequisites.title: Kohlenhydrate analysieren
wholePrerequisites.description: Die lernende Person kann Mono-, Di- und Polysaccharide anhand ihres Molekülbaus unterscheiden, Fischer- und Haworth-Projektionen, D-/L-Konfiguration, Anomere und Fehling-Probe deuten sowie chemische und physiologische Eigenschaften strukturbezogen begründen.
wholePrerequisites.descriptionEn: The learner can distinguish mono-, di-, and polysaccharides by molecular structure, interpret Fischer and Haworth projections, D/L configuration, anomers, and Fehling test, and justify chemical and physiological properties from structure.
